programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: IPE tuition & financial aid page (2027-29): Year 1 Rs 5,00,000 (admission 50,000 + tuition 3,00,000 + IT/library/activities 1,50,000) + Year 2 Rs 4,00,000 (tuition 3,00,000 + IT/library/activities 1,00,000) = Rs 9,00,000; 2027-29 brochure: 'Rs. 9 Lakhs for 2 years. Hostel Fee separate'. Excludes hostel (Rs 1.2-2.0 lakh per year), transport (Rs 45,000 per year) and refundable caution deposit Rs 15,000. Same fee shown for IPE's PGDM variants.
programs.intakeNote: IPE Information Brochure 2027-29: PGDM intake 180. Other programmes: PGDM-Marketing 60, PGDM-BFS 120, PGDM-IB 60, PGDM-HRM 60, PGDM-Business Analytics 60.
programs.salaryYear: PGDM Class of 2025 (page marks placements as 'in process')
programs.placementNote: IPE 'Placement details for last 3 years' page: Class of 2025 course-wise - PGDM 78.5% placed, highest Rs 16.25 L, average Rs 7.03 L (placements marked 'in process'). Institute-wide 2025: 81.4% placed, highest Rs 20 LPA, average Rs 7.02 L; 2024: 91.5%, 14.13 L, 7.02 L. Median not published; audit not stated.

selectionProcess.name: Online application + valid CAT/XAT/MAT/ATMA/CMAT/GMAT (brochure also lists TGICET) score
selectionProcess.detail: Eligibility: bachelor's degree with at least 50% (45% SC/ST/PC). Shortlisting on test score.

selectionProcess.name: Psychometric test, short essay, group discussion and personal interview
selectionProcess.weightage: Management aptitude test 40, academic record 20, personal interview 35, sports/extracurricular/academic & gender diversity 5
selectionProcess.detail: Interviews at IPE Hyderabad and major cities, physical or online. Selection steps per 2027-29 brochure; weights per admission procedure page.

selectionWeightage.note: Evaluation criteria as published on the IPE admission procedure page (no batch year stated).

keyDates.notes: Admissions open for 2027-29. Entrance tests per brochure: CAT 29 Nov 2026; MAT 20 & 27 Dec 2026; XAT 3 Jan 2027; CMAT 7 Feb 2027 (examDate = CAT). IPE application deadline not published in the brochure.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
